accepted_sources_summary.summary: Canonical outcome-core baseline after accepted packages 1 and 2.
Outcome-only state, PDA, instruction, event, and deterministic math surfaces.
Replay verifier by signature plus localnet smoke and negative coverage.
Four active blessed canonical devnet signatures replay to MATCH / OK, including W3O1 v3 rank_desc and closest_to.
Operator-side resolve is bundled without monorepo-only runtime paths.
Adapter evidence remains docs-only and is not exported as public code.

Unicorn-G entropy source (global-omega / RngV2State): SlotHashes-derived u, Groth16-verified y, seal + attest + wrong-proof rejection, validated end-to-end on devnet. Canonical opt-in path; default entropy stays SlotHashes; relies on a Groth16 trusted setup (devnet RSA modulus). Details under unicorn_g_b8.

Sortition-by-Claim v1.4.0 commit-reveal ticket draw: lifecycle create/register/seal/claim, 5/5 negative cases, claim CU < 10k, winner distribution matches binomial. Canonical path; replay-by-signature stays the default. Details under sortition_v140.

Sortition economics v1.4.1 optional fee layer (entry fee + close-skim): positive path + 9/9 negatives, dedicated treasury, byte-compatible with 1.4.0 draws. Canonical. Details under sortition_economics_v141.

unicorn_g_b8.scope: global-omega / RngV2State Unicorn-G entropy path; opt-in (default entropy stays SlotHashes)

sortition_v140.scope: Sortition-by-Claim commit-reveal ticket draw; canonical alternative resolution path

sortition_economics_v141.scope: Optional sortition fee layer (entry fee + close-skim); byte-compatible with 1.4.0 draws (fee fields 0 = disabled)

conditions_fc7.scope: OddSol conditions scoring — score committed prediction slips (odds × proven facts) into per-entrant S + ranking; attestation-only (no fund custody)

parity.scope: Rust (on-chain) ↔ TS SDK ↔ OddSol scoreExpress byte-identical
parity.overflow_contract: coefficient rejected (not silent 0) on u128/u64 overflow; TS score_fixed is exact bigint

live_evidence.note: VRE-operated commit+resolve verified end-to-end; OddSol integration live in production against this program

notes: This repository is the standalone repo and the reviewer/runtime flow runs from repo root.
Historical localnet signatures are not treated as evergreen public acceptance fixtures.
Legacy compiled spec and metrics appendix files are not part of the active standalone runtime surface.
The ecosystem monorepo continues separately and is not required for replay or operator resolve flows.
The canonical program is 6QtLot... on devnet; the blessed signature set covers Raffle, Rewards Selection, Trading Competition, and Prediction Market.
Sortition v1.4.0, sortition economics v1.4.1, and the Unicorn-G entropy source are canonical paths on the same program; replay-by-signature stays the default resolution path and Unicorn-G is opt-in.
Mainnet is a separate, later effort; this evidence describes the canonical devnet protocol.
